channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook will allow users to access Copilot directly while previewing files, providing smart suggestions and summaries. This change affects users who preview documents in Outlook. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Engage Communities in Microsoft Teams
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Viva Engage communities will now be accessible within Teams, facilitating connection and collaboration across the organization. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Seamless Search and Chat Integration
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 Chat will integrate conversational AI with Copilot Search, allowing users to interact seamlessly with search results and chat. This affects users engaging with knowledge management. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Save your event as template to reuse event configurations
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Organizers for Teams events instances will now be able to reuse their event configurations in the Events app in Teams. Organizers can save these configurations as a template in the Events app to use again for future Teams events. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Upload custom backgrounds for Teams events
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools can now upload custom backgrounds in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. This enhancement allows organizations to display their brand identity by replacing the default backgrounds with their own images, such as co (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – notification and improved search capabilities
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview enhances Data Security Investigations with notification capabilities and improved search functions. Investigators will receive alerts on key events and benefit from better query building. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams will disable the default profanity filter for live captions, affecting users who have not set a preference. This may result in unfiltered profanity appearing in captions. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: BYOD space peripheral health signals and reports in the Pro Management portal
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams admins can now manage BYOD peripherals with new health reports in the Pro Management portal, flagging issues like faults or missing devices. A Teams Shared Devices license is required for room reports. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention for endpoints - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for embedded images in endpoint
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] This release will extend OCR support from standalone images (JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, and PDF) to images embedded inside the following files and file types: Office files (XLSX, DOCX, PPTX), container files (zip, rar, 7z, and more), and PDF files. Image-only PDF files are already supported, and thi (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Tenant-level dashboard for Interpreter
item.description: [NEW] Get a clear, centralized view of how Interpreter is used across your organization. Monitor adoption, track usage trends, and understand costs—all in one place. Designed for tenant admins, it helps you stay in control, optimize performance, and confidently scale Interpreter across your teams. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Copilot Chat leverages embedded images for richer, more accurate answers.
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot can now interpret images in Word, PowerPoint, and PDF files to provide richer answers, enhancing user experience. This affects users leveraging Copilot for complex queries. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 will launch a new file and folder sharing experience with a single hero link for access control. This change affects all users sharing files. (GA: August CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft 365, OneDrive, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Word

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
item.description: [NEW] AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress and understand enforcement coverage. They proactively identify impacted devices, explain root causes of sync failures, and guide admins with recommended actions to quickly diagnose and resolve issues. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - Advanced Review Set Explorer
item.description: [NEW] The Advanced Review Set Explorer empowers reviewers to harness the power of real-time big data analytics on their review set data. This tool enhances data analysis by offering insights such as identifying top item types, spotting patterns, and trends within the review set. Reviewers can utilize powe (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Assistant field visibility in Organization view
item.description: [NEW] Teams now displays assistant information in the Organization view on the profile card and in the Org Explorer, making it easier to identify a key support contact for executive coordination and scheduling. This designation is informational only and does not grant permissions, change roles, or affect (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High
item.description: [NEW] We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High cloud. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: [NEW] Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, t (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
item.description: [NEW] Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. Passkeys created in Edge can now be synced seamlessly, improving sign-in experience while maintaining strong security standards. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Validate Edge builds early with enterprise preview
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge will offer an enterprise preview for admins to flight pre-release builds to users, simplifying the testing process. This affects IT admins managing Edge. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Extensions monitoring in the Edge management service
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Admins can now monitor installed extensions across managed users in Microsoft Edge, allowing them to manage user requests for blocked extensions. This change affects IT admins managing Edge. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will expand Insider Risk Management to include AI agents, allowing for monitoring and risk scoring based on their activities. This change affects organizations using AI agents. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] A new PAYGO consumption-based meter for SharePoint storage will allow organizations to pay for extra storage as needed, simplifying the purchasing process. This change affects administrators managing SharePoint storage. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft 365

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Account Switcher for Copilot Tab
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] You can now switch between accounts on the Copilot tab. Simply swipe left to open the the left-navigation and select from the list of supported accounts. Updated June 9, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. (GA: September CY2025) — Outlook

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Viva Insights Copilot Dashboard will start showing Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat prompt category metrics within Copilot Chat (work) insights. #copilotcontrolsystem Updated June 9, 2026: Public preview is now available. We have incorporated initial customer feedback and are continuing to evaluate additi (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Viva

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] In Outlook for Android, shareable links will now display as document names in meeting descriptions, with permission management available directly. This affects users sharing documents in meetings. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Improved results when filtering your message list
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook for iOS improves message filtering by allowing users to search for older messages that aren't synced. This change affects mobile users of Outlook. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Reply Options for EML Attachments

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Reply Options for EML Attachments

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Font Search in Outlook for Android

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Font Search in Outlook for iOS

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce a Learning agent to help employees with personalized microlearning. This change affects all users of Microsoft 365 Copilot. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Users on iPhone and iPad can share Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files to the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, allowing them to preview files or chat about them. This affects users sharing files from third-party apps. (GA: October CY2025) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Preview and chat with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on iPhone
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The Microsoft 365 Copilot app on iPhone will allow users to preview Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files and interact with Copilot Chat directly within the preview. This affects users accessing these file types on iPhone. (GA: October CY2025) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Open Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Files in Copilot Chat
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Users will be able to open Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files directly in Copilot Chat, streamlining document access. This change affects users who utilize Copilot for document-related tasks. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v. 149 - Unifying Copilot Chat policy controls
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge will standardize the Copilot Chat policy controls, meaning the Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policy will be the only one affecting Copilot Chat's appearance and functionality. This impacts users of Microsoft Edge with Copilot Chat. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Edge, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v.149 - Modern, unified, and updated Look and Feel
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge will receive a unified update to its Look and Feel, affecting the user experience across Microsoft AI surfaces. This impacts all Edge users. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Proactive AI insight powered by Data Security Posture Management
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview's Data Security Investigations now provides AI insights to identify potential data exfiltration risks. This feature is aimed at security teams monitoring sensitive data. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will introduce a Device Health Reporting Dashboard for admins to monitor device health and readiness for policy updates. This change impacts IT administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Add support for Recommended Labels in Outlook mobile

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Add support for Recommended Labels in Outlook mobile
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook mobile will support recommended sensitivity labels when composing emails, applying them automatically if policies are enabled. This feature helps users manage sensitive information more effectively. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copy Tables in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Users can now copy tables created in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for use elsewhere. This feature is beneficial for users who work with tables in Copilot. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Output Formats

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v. 149 - Clarify choices surrounding third-party cookie settings

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Onboarding emails for Leaders

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneDrive: Transfer ownership of departing employees’ files with ease
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneDrive will simplify the transfer of files from departing employees, with improved account cleanup emails and bulk transfer features. This change impacts managers handling offboarding processes. (GA: October CY2025) — OneDrive

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Shared & Delegate Mailbox Scheduling for Events
item.description: Empower Chiefs of Staff and delegated roles to efficiently organize events on behalf of leaders or teams using shared or delegated mailboxes. By sending trusted invites from the chosen mailbox, this capability ensures consistent identity, improved trust, and smoother event setup. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Room availability signal for Teams events
item.description: In the Events app in Teams, Teams events organizers will now be able to see if the chosen room or space they have selected for their event is available at the designated time or not. This feature is available for any Teams event organizer with a Teams Enterprise license. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
item.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Emails marked with External to be supported as Rules conditions
item.description: The External tag on an email, set by the ExternalInOutlook feature, will now be usable as a condition in Outlook Inbox Rules. This change also makes available the ability to create or modify these Rules on the new Outlook for Windows, Outlook Web, and Outlook for Mac. (GA: June CY2026) — Exchange, Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for presenters in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Presenters can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings. This feature enables seamless live presentations. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Search in quick sharing experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling search within the quick sharing experience, allowing users to find and attach cloud files more easily. This affects all Teams users sharing files. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Enforce DLP protection upon new content before its saved

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Call Transfer Improvements

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable customers to book appointments from a live chat widget on your website
item.description: The Teams live chat widget now allows customers to schedule appointments directly from a business's website. This change affects businesses using the chat widget. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
item.description: Users can now chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents directly within Teams chat, enhancing support and communication. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
item.description: Teams will have an efficiency mode that reduces resource usage on low-performance devices, improving meeting quality. This change affects all Teams users on constrained hardware. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
item.description: The Queues app will be available on Teams mobile, enabling call representatives to manage call queues and customer interactions on the go. This change affects mobile Teams users handling calls. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Book future meetings directly from Teams panels
item.description: Teams panels now allow users to book future meetings directly by selecting available time slots from the calendar. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
item.description: Outlook introduces a Go to Folder feature that enables users to quickly search and navigate to any mailbox folder by typing part of the folder name. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook
